title: The Wild Veil
author: Oscar Fairweather
blurb: Jude Ashgrove, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
